content.text:
Welch Allyn — now part of **Baxter/Hillrom** — makes several ophthalmology / eye-exam tools, especially handheld diagnostic instruments.

Common **Welch Allyn ophthalmology tools** include:

- **PanOptic Plus Ophthalmoscope** — wide-view direct ophthalmoscope; current premium option, often sold in ophthalmic or diagnostic sets. ([hillrom.com](https://www.hillrom.com/en/products/ophthalmic-sets/?utm_source=openai))  
- **3.5 V Coaxial Ophthalmoscope** — classic handheld direct ophthalmoscope with coaxial optics, LED lamp options, polarizing filter, and multiple aperture settings. ([hillrom.com](https://www.hillrom.com/en/products/3-5v-coaxial-ophthalmoscope/?utm_source=openai))  
- **3.5 V AutoStep Coaxial Ophthalmoscope** — version with single-diopter lens steps for more precise focusing. ([hillrom.ca](https://www.hillrom.ca/en/products/3-5v-autostep-coaxial-ophthalmoscope/?utm_source=openai))  
- **Retinoscopes** — used for objective refraction; often included in broader Welch Allyn eye/ENT diagnostic systems. ([hillrom.com](https://www.hillrom.com/en/products/diagnostic-sets/?utm_source=openai))  
- **Diagnostic sets** — combinations of ophthalmoscope, otoscope, retinoscope, rechargeable handles, chargers, and cases. ([hillrom.com](https://www.hillrom.com/en/products/diagnostic-sets/?utm_source=openai))  
- **Binocular indirect ophthalmoscope accessories / power supplies** — older or specialty Welch Allyn ophthalmic products also exist. ([hillrom.com](https://www.hillrom.com/content/dam/hillrom-aem/us/en/marketing/products/binocular-indirect-ophthalmoscope/documents/usermanual_20090303_BIO_power_source.pdf?utm_source=openai))  

If you’re **buying for school or general clinical use**, the most relevant choices are usually:

1. **Budget/classic:** Welch Allyn 3.5 V Coaxial Ophthalmoscope  
2. **Premium/wider view:** Welch Allyn PanOptic Plus  
3. **Full set:** Welch Allyn diagnostic set with ophthalmoscope + otoscope + rechargeable handle  

If you want, I can also help you compare **PanOptic vs Coaxial**, identify a specific Welch Allyn model number, or find compatible bulbs/handles/chargers.
